## Install the client

```bash
pnpm add @forgecms/client
```

Create the client on the server. A key that reaches a browser bundle is a leaked key.

## Error codes

A rejected request carries one of the [`ForgeErrorCode`](/reference/generated/forge-error-code) values.

:::code client.ts

```ts
/** Reasons a Forge request can fail. */
export enum ForgeErrorCode {
  /** The API key is missing or revoked. */
  Unauthorized = 'unauthorized',
  /** The collection or entry does not exist. */
  NotFound = 'not_found',
  /** Too many requests; retry after the delay in the response. */
  RateLimited = 'rate_limited',
}
```

Retry only `rate_limited`; the other two need a different request, not another attempt.
